Ananya Patel
Senior Business Development Manager | Koramangala, Bengaluru, India
ananya.patel201@example.com | +91 9126657788

Seasoned sales professional with a technical background and a track record of building pipeline and closing high-value B2B deals. Focused on enterprise GTM motions, CRM-driven process improvements, and cross-functional enablement to accelerate revenue. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Koramangala only. Notice period: 90 days.

Experience

Trellis Systems — Mar 2026 - Present
Senior Business Development Manager
- Built and managed an outbound territory using SFDC to track accounts and activities, generating a pipeline of $1.6M within six months through targeted outreach and qualification. (B2B Sales, SFDC)
- Closed three strategic enterprise pilots worth $420K ARR by leading commercial negotiation, pricing strategy, and contract terms with procurement teams. (Negotiation, B2B Sales)
- Partnered with product and marketing to define ICP and messaging; improved demo-to-opportunity conversion from 8% to 18% by refining qualification criteria and playbooks in SFDC. (SFDC, B2B Sales)

Freshworks — Oct 2022 - Feb 2026
Account Executive
- Prospected and closed mid-market accounts across SaaS and services verticals, achieving 120% of quota in FY2024 by converting a $950K pipeline into $420K closed revenue. (Lead Generation, SFDC)
- Implemented a cadence of multi-channel Lead Generation campaigns and reuseable templates, increasing SQL velocity by 35% quarter-over-quarter. (Lead Generation)
- Maintained clean opportunity hygiene in SFDC, reducing forecast variance from 22% to 9% through disciplined stage criteria and weekly forecast reviews. (SFDC)

Finlytics — Dec 2020 - Sep 2022
Sales Manager
- Led a team of four AEs focusing on enterprise analytics deals; introduced standardized negotiation playbooks that shortened average deal cycle from 110 to 72 days. (Negotiation, SFDC)
- Drove account expansion and upsell motions, increasing net revenue retention to 118% by identifying cross-sell opportunities and executing account plans in SFDC. (SFDC)
- Trained sales reps on objection handling and closing techniques; improved team win-rate from 26% to 41% in 12 months. (Negotiation)

Helio Energy — Sep 2016 - Nov 2020
Sales Manager
- Developed B2B Sales channels for commercial solar solutions, securing long-term contracts worth INR 3.2 Cr by targeting large real-estate and manufacturing clients. (B2B Sales)
- Established Lead Generation processes with trade shows, partnerships and inbound qualification that increased qualified leads by 240% year-over-year. (Lead Generation, B2B Sales)
- Implemented SFDC to centralize pipeline data and reporting; reduced administrative time by 30% and improved forecast accuracy. (SFDC)

Projects
- Internal Sales Playbook (Freshworks): Created a repeatable outbound playbook leveraging SFDC lists and email cadences that scaled across two regions and was adopted by 18 reps.
- Opportunity Hygiene Automation (Trellis Systems): Designed SFDC validation rules and dashboards using cross-team inputs to reduce missing data fields by 85%.

Skills
Sales & GTM: B2B Sales, Lead Generation, Negotiation
CRM & Tools: SFDC, Jira
